intro: Vatican City has no Olympic team, but it does have its own sports clubs.

chapters.title: Clubs
text: Vatican employees play in their own football league, and there is a Vatican cricket club and an athletics team.

chapters.title: Fans
text: Many staff support Italian football clubs, and popes have blessed many sports teams.

keyTerms.meaning: A group of teams that play each other in a season.

items.title: Vatican Athletics
items.subtitle: Running
items.text: A team of priests, nuns and staff.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where Vatican City's biggest sporting moments happen.

items.title: Vatican Athletics
items.text: A running club made up of Vatican staff is founded.
